items.title: Xavier Worthy: Considered day-to-day, per Reid
items.text:
Coach Andy Reid said Monday that Worthy (hamstring) is considered day-to-day in advance of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Deemed day-to-day by Reid
items.text:
Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Monday that Mahomes (elbow) is considered day-to-day as this Sunday's game against the Falcons approaches, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drew Lock: Encouraging results regarding oblique injury
items.text:
Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Lock's tests on his oblique injury were "good," and the issue is something the QB is expected to manage ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders,  Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Not ready to return in Week 10
items.text:
Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) won't be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Expected to travel with team to Munich
items.text:
Brown (knee) is trending toward traveling with the Patriots for their trip to Munich, where the team will face the Lions this coming weekend, according to Mark Daniels of MassLive.com.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
